column1: # tests/air/VERIFY_KNOWN.tsv -- corpus sources whose emitted .air breaks a validity rule (docs/specs/AIR.md "Validity").
# Columns: case id (source path, '/' -> '_'), then violation counts V1 V2 V3 V4. Sources not listed have 0 0 0 0.
# EXACT match is required in both directions: a NEW violation fails the test, and a FIXED one must be removed here.
# Every row is a producer (pfront lowering) defect, not a property of the source programs:
#   V3 = a variable the lowering emitted but never bound. Today this is: meta builtins (quote/eval/reify), session
#   endpoints (tx/rx), effect resume (`k`), clause pattern binders of TRS rules / enum payloads, and block-scope leaks.
#   A consumer must treat such a free variable as UNSUPPORTED, never as an external symbol.
